docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $500.00 FILED BY WALLER MICHAEL C AS TO DEFENDANT SEBESTYEN GREEN PAM ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-13-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 08
